name: Check in, renew or win back customers
summary: Works out which customers are due a check-in, renewal or win-back, drafts the campaign for each group in the business's email tool, and queues every send for approval. Crons read and draft; a person approves every send.

all.evidence: 21 discovery calls read, 6 describe how they check in on, renew or win back customers; the most-named tools (ActiveCampaign, Freshdesk, spreadsheets) have no platform support rows in the evidence, so the build uses the platforms that do

covered_by.due-list: cron (Mailchimp list members, by group tag and last change)
covered_by.segment: settings (each group is a tag and a saved segment the owner builds in Mailchimp)
covered_by.call-customer: not covered (phone calls are a person's work)
covered_by.handle-replies: cron (flags unread conversations with a note; a person answers)
covered_by.renewal-offer: not covered (renewal terms come from the business's own system)
covered_by.win-back-offer: not covered (offers are a person's decision)
covered_by.book-in: not covered (bookings run in the business's own diary)
covered_by.close-renewal: not covered (payment and signing happen in the business's own system)
covered_by.update-records: draft (member notes log each draft and each reply)
covered_by.schedule-next: not covered (next dates come from the business's own system)

crons.name: due-list
crons.summary: Read subscribed members in each group and record who is due a check-in or win-back.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Create one Mailchimp campaign draft per group with due customers and queue its send for approval.

crons.name: replies
crons.summary: Find unread replies to check-in campaigns and note that a person needs to answer.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a campaign in draft status, its content, a member note, and reads. The campaign send is a live operation and waits for a person.

mailchimp.covers: due-list, draft campaign, approved send, reply notes

gaps: GoHighLevel: its docs mark segment, draft-message, send-outreach, handle-replies and update-records as yes, but the vendor spec leaves the contact search body with no fields, so no adapter is built. Add it once the contact search fields are confirmed.
HubSpot: mapped operations exist, but its docs mark only three steps yes and none for replies or renewals. No adapter built.
ActiveCampaign, Freshdesk, spreadsheets, QuickWorks, FileMaker and the internal portal are named in the calls but have no platform support rows in the evidence, so no adapter is built for them.

The real due date (renewal, service or membership end) lives in the business's own system, not in Mailchimp. Mailchimp last change is only a proxy for when a customer was last active. Connect the business's job or membership system before relying on due dates.
Mailchimp groups depend on the owner tagging members and building the saved segment first. The cron reads the tag; the send goes to the saved segment.
Calls, renewal and win-back offers, bookings, close-out, chasing silence and scheduling the next date are judgment or a person's work, with no platform operation in this build.
Runtime: no change needed for this build. A send approved after the owner edits the campaign in Mailchimp goes out with the edited content.

evidence.platforms: vendor docs for GoHighLevel, HubSpot and Mailchimp mapped step by step; the Mailchimp adapter is the only one built
